I have successfully updated the landing page to match the style of the mockup and HTML file you shared!

### What changed to match the style:
- **Typography**: Configured the display headings to use `Montserrat` and body texts to use `Inter` in [src/app/layout.tsx](file:///c:/Users/jorda/OneDrive/Documents/SITE%20SEU%20MARQUINHO/src/app/layout.tsx).
- **Branding & Accent Colors**: Added custom themes for the gold/yellow accenting (`#ffe179`, `#ffdb58`) and deep charcoal tones (`#121414`, `#1a1c1c`, `#0d0f0f`) in [src/app/globals.css](file:///c:/Users/jorda/OneDrive/Documents/SITE%20SEU%20MARQUINHO/src/app/globals.css).
- **Hero & Content Updates**: Applied cinematic overlays, centered styling headers, bento boxes with "VER TUDO" tags, updated card buttons with hover color animations, and added the yellow "Materiais Premium Garantidos" overlapping badge in [src/app/page.tsx](file:///c:/Users/jorda/OneDrive/Documents/SITE%20SEU%20MARQUINHO/src/app/page.tsx).
- **Remote Image Support**: Whitelisted the Google User Content hostname inside [next.config.ts](file:///c:/Users/jorda/OneDrive/Documents/SITE%20SEU%20MARQUINHO/next.config.ts) to support the lifestyle backgrounds.
- **Verification**: Built and validated the application using `npm run build` (compiled successfully!).

The Next.js development server is still active in the background, so you can preview the updated layout at **[http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000)**.

For full implementation and verification details, please review [walkthrough.md](file:///C:/Users/jorda/.gemini/antigravity/brain/d50e19db-2019-4149-927b-196b859292c5/walkthrough.md).
